name: Nacre
description: Mother-of-pearl: overlapping plates of aragonite, each one a shade off the last.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -14%; top: 0; width: 76%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 38%; top: 0; width: 76%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; opacity: 0.85; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @even { -webkit-transform: scaleX(-1); transform: scaleX(-1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
